description: Verify that TCP moves to ESTABLISHED after receiving ACK in SYN-RCVD state (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
The last leg of the 3-way handshake: SYN-RCVD's defining transition is to ESTABLISHED on the third-leg ACK.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN → DUT replies SYN,ACK (DUT now in SYN-RCVD).
3. Tester → DUT: ACK.
4. Observation: DUT must be in ESTABLISHED (verified via UT-query).   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT reports ESTABLISHED after the third-leg ACK.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_not_established — DUT did not reach ESTABLISHED
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN,ACK within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT reached ESTABLISHED on third-leg ACK — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
